title: Phase 1 Infrastructure: win_rate objective + profit_target_exit + param_space JSONs
description: Build the shared foundation needed by all subsequent phases: (1) add win_rate as an optimization objective in optimizer._objective_value(), (2) add win_rate support to validation_gate() with CPCV/WFO win_rate pass criteria, (3) create profit_target_exit() shared function in _runtime.py, (4) create per-strategy param_space JSON files for optimizer search spaces including RSI threshold ranges.
action: Add `if objective == "win_rate": return float(result.win_rate)` at optimizer.py:169 before the final fallback. Change gate.py:41 default from `optimize_objective: str = "sharpe"` to `optimize_objective: str = "sharpe"` (keep default, add win_rate pass-through). Add win_rate check in gate.py after DSR check: `if optimize_objective == "win_rate": verify avg win_rate across CPCV paths >= 0.50`. Create function `profit_target_exit(close: pd.Series, entries: pd.Series, profit_take_pct: float, max_holding_bars: int) -> pd.Series` in _runtime.py. Create 3 JSON files: trend_following_params.json, mean_reversion_params.json, volatility_breakout_params.json in quantflow/config/strategies/.

criteria: grep -c 'win_rate' quantflow/strategy/research/optimizer.py returns >= 2 (line with objective check + line with result.win_rate)
grep 'win_rate' quantflow/strategy/validation/gate.py returns match for win_rate pass-through or check logic
python -c "from quantflow.strategy.templates._runtime import profit_target_exit; print('OK')" succeeds
python -c "from quantflow.strategy.research.optimizer import StrategyOptimizer; print('OK')" succeeds
ruff check quantflow/strategy/research/optimizer.py quantflow/strategy/validation/gate.py quantflow/strategy/templates/_runtime.py passes with 0 errors

convergence.definition_of_done: All 4 infrastructure pieces functional: optimizer supports win_rate objective, gate supports win_rate validation, profit_target_exit is importable from _runtime, and all 3 param_space JSON files exist with valid JSON

reference.pattern: Follow existing _runtime.py function patterns (pure functions with pd.Series inputs/outputs, from __future__ annotations, type hints)

rationale.chosen_approach: Infrastructure first — all 3 subsequent phases depend on these building blocks. profit_target_exit must exist before templates can wire it. win_rate objective must exist before validation can use it. param_space JSONs must exist before optimizer can search expanded parameter ranges.
decision_factors: BacktestResult already has win_rate field (backtest.py line 35), so optimizer just needs the dispatch branch
gate.py already passes optimize_objective through to CPCV/WFO, so win_rate objective flows automatically; just need the threshold check
profit_target_exit in _runtime.py follows the module's pattern of shared numeric helpers

risks: profit_target_exit implementation must handle edge cases: no entries, overlapping positions, NaN values
